content.short: TownSquare is a modular money market on Monad pairing curated vaults with lending markets.
content.description: TownSquare is a cross-chain, non-custodial lending protocol whose yield comes from lending to institutions and RWA issuers. Depositors enter an institution-backed yield vault or supply its crosschain liquidity markets. A WrappedTLP token and credit vault carry the institutional loan exposure, while automated loop vaults let holders of yield-bearing assets lever that yield up. The protocol runs on Monad.
content.meta: Curated vaults over modular lending markets, separating risk policy from protocol code.
